shapes.frame_eqs_str: a.rad = 0.05 + a.bass_att * 0.05; a.x = 0.5 + Math.sin(a.time * 0.4) * 0.12; a.y = 0.5 + Math.cos(a.time * 0.6) * 0.12; a.r = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(a.time * 0.8); a.g = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(a.time * 1.1); a.b = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(a.time * 1.3);
a.ang = a.time * 0.3; a.rad = 0.1 + a.mid_att * 0.05; a.x = 0.5 - Math.sin(a.time * 0.25) * 0.15; a.y = 0.5 - Math.cos(a.time * 0.4) * 0.15;

waves.point_eqs_str: a.angle = a.sample * 6.28 + a.time * 0.4; a.dist = 0.2 + a.value1 * 0.1 * a.bass_att; a.x = 0.5 + Math.sin(a.angle) * a.dist; a.y = 0.5 + Math.cos(a.angle) * a.dist; a.r = 0.0; a.g = 0.8; a.b = 1.0; a.a = 0.4;

a.angle = a.sample * 6.28 - a.time * 0.2; a.dist = 0.1 + a.value2 * 0.08 * a.mid_att; a.x = 0.5 + Math.sin(a.angle) * a.dist; a.y = 0.5 + Math.cos(a.angle) * a.dist; a.r = 1.0; a.g = 0.2; a.b = 0.7; a.a = 0.3;

frame_eqs_str: a.vol = (a.bass + a.mid + a.treb) * 0.33; a.vol_avg = a.vol_avg * 0.98 + a.vol * 0.02; a.zoom_time += (0.012 + a.bass * 0.015) * 0.55; a.q1 = a.zoom_time; a.x_focus = -0.7 + Math.sin(a.time * 0.05) * 0.05; a.y_focus = 0.27015 + Math.cos(a.time * 0.07) * 0.03; a.q2 = a.x_focus; a.q3 = a.y_focus; a.q4 = -0.745 + Math.sin(a.time * 0.03) * 0.08 + a.mid_att * 0.01; a.q5 = 0.113 + Math.cos(a.time * 0.04) * 0.06 + a.bass_att * 0.01; a.q6 = Math.sin(a.time * 0.1) * 0.5 + 0.5; a.q7 = Math.cos(a.time * 0.14) * 0.5 + 0.5; a.q8 = Math.sin(a.time * 0.25) * 0.5 + 0.5;
warp: shader_body { float t = q1; float period = 4.0; float t1 = mod(t, period); float t2 = mod(t + period * 0.5, period); float zoom1 = exp(-t1); float zoom2 = exp(-t2); vec2 focus = vec2(q2, q3); vec2 c = vec2(q4, q5); vec2 z1 = (uv - 0.5) * 2.5 * zoom1 + focus; float iter1 = 0.0; for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) { if (dot(z1, z1) > 4.0) break; float temp = z1.x * z1.x - z1.y * z1.y + c.x; z1.y = 2.0 * z1.x * z1.y + c.y; z1.x = temp; iter1 += 1.0; } float nu1 = 0.0; if (iter1 < 40.0) { float log_zn = log(dot(z1, z1)) / 2.0; float nu_val = log(log_zn / log(2.0)) / log(2.0); nu1 = iter1 + 1.0 - nu_val; } vec3 col1 = vec3(0.0); if (iter1 < 40.0) { col1 = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(3.0 + nu1 * 0.25 + vec3(0.0, 0.6, 1.0)); } vec2 z2 = (uv - 0.5) * 2.5 * zoom2 + focus; float iter2 = 0.0; for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) { if (dot(z2, z2) > 4.0) break; float temp = z2.x * z2.x - z2.y * z2.y + c.x; z2.y = 2.0 * z2.x * z2.y + c.y; z2.x = temp; iter2 += 1.0; } float nu2 = 0.0; if (iter2 < 40.0) { float log_zn = log(dot(z2, z2)) / 2.0; float nu_val = log(log_zn / log(2.0)) / log(2.0); nu2 = iter2 + 1.0 - nu_val; } vec3 col2 = vec3(0.0); if (iter2 < 40.0) { col2 = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(3.0 + nu2 * 0.25 + vec3(0.0, 0.6, 1.0)); } float blend = abs(mod(t / (period * 0.5), 2.0) - 1.0); vec3 col = mix(col1, col2, blend); vec3 prev = texture(sampler_main, uv).xyz * 0.45; ret = col + prev; }
comp: shader_body { vec3 main_col = texture(sampler_main, uv).xyz; vec3 blur_col = (texture(sampler_blur1, uv).xyz * scale1) + bias1; vec3 col = main_col + blur_col * 0.6; vec3 palette = vec3(q6, q7, q8); col = col * (vec3(1.0) + palette * 0.3); col = pow(col, vec3(1.3)); ret = col; }
